C_sk_rhea_kell.name: Rhea Kell
C_sk_rhea_kell.role: captain of Slip Knife; her authority rests on promises kept and routes survived rather than ceremony
C_sk_rhea_kell.voice: measured, dry, practical; she rarely raises her voice and never makes a promise casually
C_sk_rhea_kell.visualAnchor: early-40s woman with a lean weathered face, dark hair cut to the jaw with a few silver strands, compact runner jacket over patched pressure layers, scarred utility gloves, small chevron-notched knife at her belt

C_sk_tomas_reeve.name: Tomas Reeve
C_sk_tomas_reeve.role: navigator who reads blockade geometry as gaps, timing, and human habits
C_sk_tomas_reeve.voice: quiet and exact; speaks in short complete observations about spacing, timing, and what other ships are likely to do next
C_sk_tomas_reeve.visualAnchor: lean man in his early-to-mid 40s, graying dark curls, narrow thoughtful face, old headset around his neck, layered charcoal navigation vest with faded cyan stitching, permanently ink-smudged fingers

C_sk_nadi_korr.name: Nadi Korr
C_sk_nadi_korr.role: chief mechanic responsible for keeping Slip Knife fast enough to deserve its name
C_sk_nadi_korr.voice: blunt, technically specific, darkly funny under pressure; complains freely but gives clear limits
C_sk_nadi_korr.visualAnchor: stocky mid-30s woman with close-cropped black hair, broad grease-marked hands, sleeveless patched engineering coveralls over a pressure undersuit, tool harness, burn-scarred forearm guards

C_sk_bram_ellis.name: Bram Ellis
C_sk_bram_ellis.role: loadmaster who treats mass, restraint, and cargo integrity as matters of survival
C_sk_bram_ellis.voice: precise and unsentimental; counts before speaking and dislikes anyone treating cargo as an abstraction
C_sk_bram_ellis.visualAnchor: broad-shouldered man in his mid-50s with a shaved head, short gray beard, heavy cargo vest, old magnetic boots and a folding mass slate clipped to his chest

C_sk_emi_varn.name: Emi Varn
C_sk_emi_varn.role: manifest specialist and market runner who knows customs habits, docking favors, route gossip, and which official rule is actually being enforced today
C_sk_emi_varn.voice: fast, socially alert and conversational; jokes while working but becomes very plain when a bargain turns dangerous
C_sk_emi_varn.visualAnchor: small quick-moving woman in her late 20s with curly copper-brown hair tied high, expressive dark eyes, layered Verge street clothes under a short pressure coat, wrist full of route tokens and market chits

C_sk_jonas_pell.name: Jonas Pell
C_sk_jonas_pell.role: young Luminara cooperative cargo representative assigned to accompany the grain; competent with food logistics but new to blockade-runner culture
C_sk_jonas_pell.voice: earnest and literal without being naive; asks practical questions and notices the human cost behind logistics
C_sk_jonas_pell.visualAnchor: early-20s man with an open narrow face, sandy hair cut short, green Luminara work jacket, clean cooperative cargo tags, soft gloves unsuited to a runner deck at the start of the issue
